name: 88310 · Alamogordo, NM
findings: ZIP 88310 (Alamogordo) has 132 nonprofit organizations. 54 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 47 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 88310 (Alamogordo) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 88310 (Alamogordo) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 47 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.
